name: plan_source_detect
description: Detect whether a target checkout contains an openspec/ directory. Routes existing OpenSpec projects to OpenSpec planning; otherwise ordinary supplied documents are used directly.

repoPath.description: Path to the target checkout to inspect for an openspec/ directory. Must resolve to an existing directory.

mode.description: Planning mode selected based on whether the checkout has an openspec/ directory.

useOpenSpec.description: True when the checkout contains an openspec/ directory.

openspecPath.description: Absolute path to the openspec/ directory when useOpenSpec is true, else empty string.
